rationale.complete: Rounds 1, 1b and 2: graded style rival (within vs pooled maps, genre-controlled formatting and function words, synthetic style-only reference), newcomer enculturation (20 joiners), family coupling at the read-out call (ledger reads, in-flight placebo) with power analysis. Confirmatory C1-C6 not run.
rationale.faithfulness: Round 2 revises round 1: the family field is mostly but not only style (32-47% survives a within-agent style map; round 1's pooled rival was biased), and content couples more within labs at the read-out call (8/8 units), about half lab-level susceptibility. Talk has no family term.
rationale.usefulness: Use within-agent, not pooled, style correction before embedding comparisons across vendors; same-vendor reads move content ~1.7x more; vendor does not change who replies.
